newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares close up slightly in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares close up slightly in light trade.

text.p: Shares managed slight gains at Lithuania's listless bourse on Friday, as central market turnover fizzled out but banks were relatively active in block trades.
Brokers say block trades will continue for some time to provide activity on the otherwise lacklustre stock exchange.
"The central market is not so active because brokers are on holiday now," said one broker.
Official list shares advanced 6.43 points to close at 888.38 points and group A shares inched up 1.74 points to 1875.90 points.
Central market turnover fizzled to 230,000 litas from 656,000 litas, while block trades turned over a more respectable 1.1 million litas.
Hermis Bank saw 767,000 litas turnover at 187 litas a share in block trades, while rising to 185 litas from 184 litas and turning over 59,000 litas on the central market.
Brokers say Hermis shares are drying up at this level and expect another advance toward the 200 litas mark in coming weeks.
"It's a good oportunity now," said one broker.
Vilniaus Bank advanced to 235 litas from 230 litas amid 43,000 litas central market turnover.
Vilniaus Bank saw 117,000 litas worth of block trades at 233 litas.
